calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_end_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' ORDER BY period_start_date

SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) keys, sum(net_amount) net, max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-25' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
daily AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1,2),
ctrl AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_sales) cs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT 'calendar Sep' w, SUM(d.ns) mine, SUM(c.cs) ctrl_all, SUM(CASE WHEN d.store_id=900 THEN d.ns END) web_mine, SUM(CASE WHEN c.store_id=900 THEN c.cs END) web_ctrl
FROM daily d FULL JOIN ctrl c USING (business_date, store_id) WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'P05', SUM(d.ns), SUM(c.cs), SUM(CASE WHEN d.store_id=900 THEN d.ns END), SUM(CASE WHEN c.store_id=900 THEN c.cs END)
FROM daily d FULL JOIN ctrl c USING (business_date, store_id) WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT 'web lines w/o dispatched order' k, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected') WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'non-web lines matching web order', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup return lines', count(*)-count(DISTINCT return_line_id), 0 FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test/999 in Sep', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web order dispatch Sep by status', count(*), 0 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='processing'

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY 1, 2
